dedupe_keys.name: gtfs et siri du reseau ginko besancon lignes urbaines et periurbaines

description: GTFS et SIRI du réseau Ginko Besançon (lignes urbaines et périurbaines) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by GRAND BESANCON METROPOLE. List of urban and suburban lines, stops, and schedules of buses and trams of the Ginko urban network. Also contains the detailed route of the lines (GPS traces of the lines contained in the file 'shapes'). Attention: It also does not contain data on all school services or on demand. Coverage: GRAND BESANCON METROPOLE. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS and SIRI of the Ginko Besançon network (urban and peri-urban lines)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is GRAND BESANCON METROPOLE. Its keywords include gtfs, tram, ginko, bus, siri. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS, XML. The listing shows 2025-10-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
